name: Gorgias
task: A help desk, tickets or a shared inbox
summary: Helpdesk built for ecommerce: tickets, automations and an AI agent, priced by volume rather than by seat -- though the entry tier caps you at three users.
best_for: ecommerce support teams with seasonal or spiky volume, where per-agent pricing punishes you for having enough people on a busy week
skip_if: your volume is steady and low: 50 tickets a month is the entry allowance, and below that a shared inbox costs nothing; also skip the AI agent until you know your automated-interaction count, since that is the meter that runs away
honest_knock:
Never priced per agent is a real advantage, but it starts one tier up: the comparison table caps Starter at 3 user seats, and only Basic and above open the inbox to 500. On Basic upwards your whole team can be in there without the bill moving, which is the main reason to choose this over a per-seat helpdesk.

The cost sits on two meters instead, and both bite. Tickets beyond your allowance cost $0.40 each on Starter, $40 per extra 100 on Basic and $36 per 100 on Pro and Advanced, so a bad week costs money rather than attention. And the AI agent -- the thing the homepage leads with -- is a separate $30 a month on the entry plan, which is three times the helpdesk it sits on. So the honest entry price for the product as advertised is $40, not $10.

Count a normal month's tickets and a busy month's, and price both. Then check the AI meter separately: past the included allowance the comparison table charges $1.00 per automated interaction on Starter, $0.90 on Basic and Pro and $0.85 on Advanced (read 7 October 2026). Price your expected volume at that rate before you switch the agent on.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on gorgias.com/pricing and on the App Store listing apps.shopify.com/helpdesk, and in our own test session on 17 November 2026; first read 2026-09-08) Four plans with the AI Agent included, as gorgias.com/pricing shows them by default: Starter $40 a month, Basic $90, Pro $550 and Advanced $1,430, or $77, $471 and $1,227 a month billed annually ($924, $5,652 and $14,724 a year); Starter bills monthly only. The helpdesk and the AI Agent are priced separately inside each plan: $10 and $30 on Starter, $60 and $30 on Basic ($50 and $27 annually), $360 and $190 on Pro ($300 and $171) and $900 and $530 on Advanced ($750 and $477). The App Store listing prints only the helpdesk part, Starter $10 a month, Basic $60 or $600 a year, Pro $360 or $3,600 a year and Advanced $900 or $9,000 a year, and shows the AI Agent as an add on, so the listing's $60 Basic is the $90 Basic without the AI Agent. Starter includes 50 tickets and 30 automated interactions, Basic 300 tickets and 30 interactions, Pro 2,000 tickets and 190 interactions and Advanced 5,000 tickets and 530 interactions. It is never priced per agent, in their own words, but the seats are capped: the comparison table gives Starter 3 user seats and Basic, Pro and Advanced 500 each, while the listing calls Basic's agents unlimited and Pro's and Advanced's up to 500. Ticket overage is $0.40 a ticket on Starter; on Basic the listing and the comparison table print $40 per additional 100 tickets, and on Pro and Advanced $36 per 100, which the page's structured data gives as $0.40 and $0.36 a ticket; neither page says whether part of a block of 100 is billed in full. Past the included interactions the comparison table prices the AI Agent at $1.00 an interaction on Starter, $0.90 on Basic and Pro and $0.85 on Advanced; the FAQ in the page's structured data says $0.90 on annual plans and $1.00 on monthly ones, and the same structured data still names $1.50, the rate the plan cards showed on 8 September. Above 5,000 conversations a month it is quote only, and that custom plan lists SSO through SAML, SCIM provisioning and an API at 4 requests a second, where every listed plan gets 2. In our own test session the 7 day trial started on Starter with the AI Agent switched on: the billing screen showed the helpdesk at $10 a month and the AI Agent at $30, both to be billed through Shopify once billing was activated. All listing charges are billed in USD every 30 days, and each plan on the listing has a 7 day free trial.
